thermal.wall: Native accepted positive non-trim simulation dt only; implicit monotone solve of gas/coolant/radiation/effective flame exchange. Reset explicitly cold; one-shot pending warm seed; native exact state restore cancels seed.
thermal.availability: Wall valid only when catalog-present, initialized and numerically valid; gas gated by valid. Absent thermal block adds no thermal state/bindings.

limitations: Effective gas flow/cp/efficiency/cooling/capacity/radiation parameters are authored estimates, not F135 station/material calibration.
Base gas follows unchanged legacy EGT schedule, including phase discontinuities; wall remains continuous under accepted integration.
Fuel split is native-demand excess, not measured burner flow. Optional representative stoichiometric ratio is not a species/dissociation chemistry model; fuel sensible enthalpy is neglected.
Thermal numerical validity does not qualify material survival, aircraft flight performance, visible gas composition or renderer radiometry.
No render-side thermal clock, upstream submission/push, publication or new GPU/performance claim.
